text:
elaine: Quick sync — we need a tight deliverable list for the launch posts: keyword set, JSON-LD schema for webinar/benchmark pages, internal-link matrix (seed -> cluster), and redirects for legacy blog slugs. Can we lock edits by EOD Wed?
marco: On it. I'll drop a 2-page KW list and canonical suggestions by this afternoon. any priority segments?
elaine: Priority = product features > benchmarking stories > how-to integration guides. Top-of-funnel focus for webinar promos.
jamal: For webinar signups we should use Event + Speakable where relevant. Example JSON-LD I usually drop into the head: ```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Launch & Benchmark Narrative",
  "startDate": "2026-04-14T10:00:00-07:00",
  "endDate": "2026-04-14T11:00:00-07:00",
  "eventStatus": "https://schema.org/EventScheduled",
  "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar"},
  "organizer": {"@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood Inference"}
}
```
sophia: taking redirect inventory. I pulled all /blog/* slugs older than 2024 into the sheet: https://drive.google.com/xxx (view+comment). Planning a 302 -> canonical for short term, then 301 after 2 weeks. thoughts?
marco: 302 -> 301 flow makes sense for A/B content testing. For long-form benchmark posts we should keep the old URLs but add canonical to the updated piece if we merge.
elaine: @sophia pls add a column for "anchor_rewrites" — we want consistent CTAs back to webinar signup + demo funnel.
sophia: done. added examples: "see benchmark results" -> /benchmark, "get a demo" -> /demo-request.
jamal: small SEO note: add speakable blocks for the key takeaways on benchmark pages so voice search surfaces the webinar. simple structure: <script type=\"application/ld+json\">{...}</script> in head.
seo-bot: crawl-report: benchmark-drafts/2026-03-18 contains 12 missing alt tags, 3 broken internal links (rows 23, 47, 92).
marco: I'll handle alt tags and fix anchors. For internal linking matrix, propose this lightweight mapping: seed post (launch overview) -> 5 cluster posts (benchmark, integration, pricing, migration, case study). Anchor text suggestions: "launch benchmarks", "how to integrate", "cost/perf comparison", "migration guide", "customer story". Keep each seed -> cluster limit to 2 contextual links.
elaine: perfect. can you output a CSV with columns: source_url, target_url, anchor_text, reason? drop in the drive folder.
marco: will do. ETA 3pm PST. :thumbsup:
sophia: redirects plan in sheet, sample rules for infra team: ```
# nginx rewrite examples
rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /new-blog/$1?utm_source=redirect permanent;
# temporary 302 example
rewrite ^/promo-old$ /promo-new$1 redirect;
```
jamal: small QA ask — when you add JSON-LD, please validate with the rich results test before pushing. I can run a smoke test after you add it.
elaine: team: final checklist by EOD Wed
- marco: KW list + anchor CSV
- jamal: schema snippets + validation
- sophia: redirect sheet + 302->301 plan
- me: stitch copy and confirm CTAs
marco: ack
sophia: ack, will ping infra for rollout window (prefer low traffic 02:00-04:00 UTC).
jamal: ack, will queue validation run once schema is in the head.
elaine: thanks all — small followup: let's keep the outreach messaging lightweight and prioritize one CTA (webinar sign-up) on top-of-funnel posts. we'll iterate post-launch based on benchmark traffic. :rocket:
